FEATURE GUIDE

Choose how updates arrive

Control update checks and installation from the Mac app’s settings.

Mac updates · Windows manual download

OverviewHow to useExampleSupport and limitsRelated features

Overview

Mac uses Sparkle signed updates. By default it checks at startup and hourly, downloads new versions and installs when idle. Existing saved preferences take precedence over these defaults.

Open Settings → Updates to see the app version and change automatic checking and automatic installation separately.

How to use

  1. Check your installed version in Settings → Updates.
  2. Choose whether the app checks automatically and installs automatically. With automatic installation off, installation asks for confirmation.
  3. For automatic installation, close app windows and let attendance saving and calendar sync finish. The app waits until it is inactive before restarting.
  4. If your older version has updates disabled or uses the old Site feed, download the current Mac release and replace the app manually once.

Example

If an update downloads while you edit an arrival or use an open settings window, HappyLulu waits. Once windows are closed, the app is inactive and attendance/calendar work has finished, it can install and restart. A prepared update can also install on normal quit.

After installation has been prepared, the update settings are temporarily locked until restart. Changing a preference cannot cancel that prepared installation. Keep your records when replacing the app; deleting attendance data is not an update step.

Support and limits

Mac 1.5.17 build33 is the current Mac release described here. Windows 1.5.13 has no automatic updater; download and replace its extracted app manually.

Signed update verification protects update packages against tampering. It does not establish Apple Developer ID signing or notarization, which remain incomplete. Installation and permission preservation on every external Mac have not been proven.

Older apps with the former Site feed need a one-time manual replacement with the GitHub-feed version. Publishing a new feed alone does not verify their automatic migration. Records and calendar connections live outside the app bundle, but actual preservation must be checked for each installation.
